name: list_meta_injector_reports
description: Lists already captured temporary Meta Injector telemetry reports in volatile server memory, returning product/run/capture identities, pagination, and measured UI-audit availability. Unavailable reports are not successful tests and do not establish absence of errors.

productId.description: Optional Shopify Product GID filter matching gid://shopify/Product/<digits>.

mode.description: Optional nonempty capture mode filter (up to 120 characters).

limit.description: Optional maximum number of report metadata entries to return (integer 1-5, default 3).

afterReportId.description: Optional pagination cursor (reportId) to return reports after.

ok.description: Whether the list operation completed without a request or server error.

status.description: Response status such as ok, unavailable, invalid_request, invalid_cursor, or error.

name: read_meta_injector_report
description: Reads bounded views or lossless UTF-8 server chunks of a captured Meta Injector report by reportId. For live_bench_state reports, prefer organized views (view='index' for drawer/field directory and counts, 'header' for diagnostics and save verification, 'review' for actionable changes/conflicts/holds, 'drawer' for one drawer including 'Description Review', or 'field' for one complete field) instead of downloading all raw chunks. Follow hasMoreChunks and nextChunkIndex when a view or report spans multiple chunks. UI-audit data is measured only when section='ui_audit' is recorded.

reportId.description: Required identifier of the captured report (e.g., srep_<sha256>).

section.description: Optional section to read: 'report' or 'ui_audit' (default 'report'). When section is 'ui_audit', view must be 'chunk' or omitted.

view.description: Optional read mode for section='report' (default 'chunk' for raw report chunks). Organized views ('index', 'header', 'review', 'drawer', 'field') require a live_bench_state snapshot.

drawer.description: Required when view='drawer' (and omitted for other views): exact drawer title from index (e.g., 'Description Review' or a manifest section heading).

fieldKey.description: Required when view='field' (and omitted for other views): exact field key, targetKey, or approvalKey (e.g., 'native_description', 'custom.generated_description').

chunkIndex.description: Optional 0-based server chunk index to read (nonnegative integer, default 0). Used for raw report/ui_audit chunks and any organized view where hasMoreChunks is true.

ok.description: Whether the read operation completed without a request, not_found, or server error.

status.description: Response status such as ok, not_measured, not_found, invalid_request, or error.
